payload.reason: The evidence indicates that LM-Base outperforms CGExpan on user-generated datasets due to its ability to handle the unique characteristics of such text, while CGExpan struggles with these challenges.

claims.text: LM-Base outperforms CGExpan on user-generated datasets due to its better handling of the characteristics of user-generated text.
SOTA methods like CGExpan do not generalize well to user-generated text benchmarks, leading to poorer performance compared to simpler models like LM-Base.
